_provenance.reference: Inferred from kiro_crew.wecom.client._handle_message, which keys on 'errcode' present with NO 'cmd' and then reads headers.req_id to tell a pong ACK from a stream-reply ACK. No live WeCom AI Bot capture exists: this fork has no WeCom bot credentials, so nothing here was observed on the wire.
_provenance.note: UNVERIFIED against the vendor. req_id deliberately equals the msg_callback_text fixture's, because a stream frame replays the inbound req_id and the ACK echoes it back -- that identity is what makes the frame routable. A success ACK may also carry errmsg; only the two fields the client requires are claimed here.
